implementation: Existing CompanyPicker searches the native master directory with its current permissions; no new directory/model/route.
Existing native portfolio list filtered by company_id finds the current accessible unique allocation. Reuse does not mutate owner, responsibilities, capacity inputs or source records.

Preserve owner/team/unit/segment/product/complexity, explicit points/hours and eligibility-exception controls. No invented weights, no automatic company creation. New allocation defaults remain visible/editable before its explicit save.

Native allocation save and group link are intentionally two explicit persisted steps. UI warns that allocation survives later cancellation or rejected group linking; no fictitious all-or-nothing promise.

Chosen allocation enters the existing customer-link reason/revision review. No link is written until the existing explicit confirmation; existing deduplication, capacity and destination scope remain enforced.
Late account/role/group-revision responses are discarded and workflow closes. Unknown mutation result requires a fresh native lookup before retry, preventing blind duplicate creation.
